label: Version 1.2.5
releaseNotes: Introduces the complete LEIE Data Processing workflow with strict full-row duplicate detection and guided resolution.
Keeps the original LEIE source name as the default output file name and saves the processed workbook as .xlsx.
Uploads LEIE files to DEV, PPD, SQA, and PROD with /in/manual_process/ as the workflow-specific default.
Verifies every SFTP upload by remote file size, bounds disconnect time, and continues to later servers after a target failure.
Includes copy-ready LEIE database validation SQL with live ETL batch ID substitution and SQL syntax colors.
Keeps Station IDs exactly as selected or randomly chooses only valid reference-table entries.
Supports matching the final 3, 4, or 5 characters of Referral Numbers and ICNs.
Generates random test SSNs and DOBs per patient by default while retaining fixed-value controls.
Provides synchronized SEOC Number and SEOC ID selection from bundled reference data.
Includes the refreshed User Guide and LEIE Upload and Validation Guide.
Uses Electron 43, electron-builder 26.15, and SheetJS 0.20.3 with automated smoke tests before merge and release.
Publishes one verified Windows Setup installer and SHA256SUMS.txt; portable builds and repository-local release folders are not generated.
Runs file processing, compression, upload tests, and LEIE work in background workers with visible progress and cancellation.
Adds large-file preflight details, dense worksheet processing, safe row and generation limits, and streaming gzip output.
Encrypts imported upload credentials with Windows-protected storage and migrates existing plaintext credentials automatically.
Retries failed uploads, continues through every selected server, and reports each server result independently.
Adds Electron sandboxing, a restrictive content security policy, IPC sender validation, HTTPS link restrictions, and protected navigation.
Adds a sticky workflow stepper, accessible live status, progress bar, Cancel control, responsive layouts, and improved keyboard semantics.
Adds Windows Electron end-to-end and installed-application smoke checks to the GitHub Actions quality gates.
Updates Electron to 43.4.1, ssh2-sftp-client to 12.1.1, Playwright to 1.62.1, and pnpm to 11.22.0.
